title: Futures point higher for Wednesday after Nvidia's earnings beat: S&P500 +0.8%, Nasdaq 100 about +1.5%
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Tuesday's close: Dow -1.6%, S&P 500 -1.0% (fourth straight loss,  
lowest close since July 29), Nasdaq Composite -0.7%.  
  
\*\*Futures as of about 3:40 PM PT (approximate):\*\*  
  
\- S&P 500: about +0.8% (\~7,417)  
\- Nasdaq 100: about +1.4% to +1.6% (\~27,514)  
\- Dow: about +0.3% (\~50,984)  
\- Russell 2000: about +0.4% (\~2,723)  
  
10-year yield \~5.10%, WTI \~$85.88, gold \~$3,858, Bitcoin \~$64,885.  
  
\*\*After-hours movers:\*\*  
  
\- NVDA about +2% to +4% (Q3 EPS $2.68 vs $2.48 expected, revenue  
$115.8B vs $109.1B, Q4 guide \~$130B)  
\- NBIS about +6%, CRWV about +4% (neocloud bounce on Nvidia)  
\- AAOI about -5% to -8% ($550M stock offering)  
\- SLS about -10% (public offering after a 160% surge)  
\- DLB about -3% (weak guidance)  
  
\*\*Wednesday (PT):\*\* LOW, TGT, TJX earnings before the open; housing  
starts 5:30 AM; pending home sales 7:00 AM; Barr 10:35 AM; FOMC  
minutes 11:00 AM; Williams 11:30 AM; Kashkari 1:15 PM; PANW earnings  
after the close.  
  
Does Nvidia's beat-and-raise change your read on a market that just  
posted four straight losses, or is the bounce fragile with the 10-year  
near 5.1%?  
  
Not financial advice. Quotes are approximate and not live.
